Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.Nice to Have Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish.Why Regrow Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits.Acerca de Regrow Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.Sobre el Rol Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.Qué Harás Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo.

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end)
  • Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components
  • Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models
  • SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data

Plusses

  • Experience with C++ development
  • Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes

Day-to-Day

You'll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You'll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.
